shellCommands.command: ls /workspace
ls -R /workspace/__agent_eval__ | head -50
node -e "console.log(require('/workspace/node_modules/next/package.json').version)" && ls /workspace/node_modules | head -40
ls /workspace/node_modules | grep -iE "playwright|puppeteer" ; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls /root/.cache 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -25

cd /workspace && (NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm start > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 3 && curl -s http://localhost:3000/ -o /tmp/home.html -w "%{http_code}\n" && curl -s 'http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale' -o /tmp/direct.html -w "direct: %{http_code} in %{time_total}s\n" && grep -c "Canvas Tote" /tmp/direct.html; grep -o "Products on sale" /tmp/direct.html | head -2

TREE='%5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22catalog%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22__PAGE__%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%5D%7D%2Cnull%2Cnull%5D'; curl -s "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: $TREE" -H 'Next-Url: /' -o /tmp/prefetch1.rsc -w "prefetch1: %{http_code} in %{time_total}s\n"; curl -s "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: $TREE" -H 'Next-Url: /' -o /tmp/prefetch2.rsc -w "prefetch2: %{http_code} in %{time_total}s\n"; grep -c "Canvas Tote" /tmp/prefetch1.rsc /tmp/prefetch2.rsc; grep -c "Loading category" /tmp/prefetch1.rsc

TREE='%5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22catalog%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22__PAGE__%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%5D%7D%2Cnull%2Cnull%5D'; curl -s -D - -o /dev/null "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: $TREE" -H 'Next-Url: /' | head -12

TREE='%5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22catalog%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22__PAGE__%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%5D%7D%2Cnull%2Cnull%5D'; for i in 1 2; do curl -sL "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: $TREE" -H 'Next-Url: /' -o /tmp/prefetch$i.rsc -w "prefetch$i: %{http_code} in %{time_total}s\n"; done; grep -c "Canvas Tote" /tmp/prefetch1.rsc /tmp/prefetch2.rsc; echo "fallback count p1:"; grep -c "Loading category" /tmp/prefetch1.rsc; wc -c /tmp/prefetch1.rsc /tmp/prefetch2.rsc

TREE='%5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22catalog%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22__PAGE__%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%5D%7D%2Cnull%2Cnull%5D'; curl -s "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale&_rsc=abc123" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: $TREE" -H 'Next-Url: /' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -D /tmp/h1.txt -o /tmp/prefetch1.rsc -w "p1: %{http_code} in %{time_total}s\n"; curl -s "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale&_rsc=def456" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: $TREE" -H 'Next-Url: /' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -o /tmp/prefetch2.rsc -w "p2: %{http_code} in %{time_total}s\n"; grep -c "Canvas Tote" /tmp/prefetch1.rsc /tmp/prefetch2.rsc; echo '--- headers:'; cat /tmp/h1.txt | head -8
head -c 1500 /tmp/prefetch2.rsc; echo; echo "=== fallback markers:"; grep -c "Loading category" /tmp/prefetch2.rsc; grep -o "Products on sale" /tmp/prefetch2.rsc

TREE='%5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22catalog%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22__PAGE__%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%5D%7D%2Cnull%2Cnull%5D'; T=$(curl -s -D - -o /dev/null "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: $TREE" -H 'Next-Url: /' | grep -i location | sed 's/.*_rsc=\([A-Za-z0-9_-]*\).*/\1/'); echo "token=$T"; curl -s "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale&_rsc=$T" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: $TREE" -H 'Next-Url: /' -o /tmp/try_a -w "A(RSC hdr + _rsc): %{http_code} in %{time_total}s size=%{size_download}\n"; curl -s "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale&_rsc=$T" -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: $TREE" -H 'Next-Url: /' -o /tmp/try_b -w "B(no RSC hdr): %{http_code} in %{time_total}s size=%{size_download}\n"; head -c 200 /tmp/try_a; echo; head -c 200 /tmp/try_b

grep -rl "next-router-state-tree" /workspace/.next/static/chunks/ 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rlE "Next-Router-State-Tree|next-router-prefetch" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled 2>/dev/null | head -5

grep -rn "next-router-prefetch" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/router-utils/ /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/base-handler* 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "redirect" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/app-render.js 2>/dev/null | grep -i rsc | head -5
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/ | head -30; grep -c postponed /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/app-render.js 2>/dev/null

grep -n "prefetch" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/app-render.js | head -30; grep -rn "only the static\|static shell\|prefetches" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/app-render.js | head
grep -n "getPrefetchingModeForPage\|PrefetchMode\|prefetchHints" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/app-render.js | head -20
sed -n 1,80p /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -A30 -i prefetch

cd /workspace && pkill -f "next-server|next start" ; NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -6 && rm -rf .next/cache && (NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm start > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 3 && curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o 'href="/catalog?category=[a-z]*"'
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ -o /tmp/home.html -w "%{http_code}\n"; grep -o 'catalog[^"]*' /tmp/home.html | sort -u | head; grep -c Featured /tmp/home.html

grep -rn "NEXT_RSC_UNION_QUERY\|_rsc" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/router-server.js /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/*request*.js 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rln "rscQuery\|union" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server 2>/dev/null | head

TREE='["",{"children":["catalog",{"children":["__PAGE__",{}]}]},"$undefined","$undefined",true]'; ET=$(node -e "console.log(encodeURIComponent(process.argv[1]))" "$TREE"); for PM in 1 2; do curl -sL "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale" -H 'RSC: 1' -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: $PM" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: $ET" -H 'Next-Url: /' -D /tmp/hh_$PM.txt -o /tmp/flight_$PM.out -w "mode$PM: %{http_code} in %{time_total}s size=%{size_download}\n"; done; grep -c "Canvas Tote" /tmp/flight_1.out /tmp/flight_2.out; grep -c "Loading category" /tmp/flight_1.out /tmp/flight_2.out; head -3 /tmp/hh_2.txt
tail -5 /tmp/next.log; (cd /workspace && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm start > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &); sleep 3; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "up: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/

TREE='["",{"children":["catalog",{"children":["__PAGE__",{}]}]},"$undefined","$undefined",true]'; ET=$(node -e "console.log(encodeURIComponent(process.argv[1]))" "$TREE"); for PM in 1 2; do curl -sL "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale" -H 'RSC: 1' -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: $PM" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: $ET" -H 'Next-Url: /' -o /tmp/flight_$PM.out -w "mode$PM: %{http_code} in %{time_total}s size=%{size_download} redirects=%{num_redirects}\n"; done; grep -c "Canvas Tote" /tmp/flight_1.out /tmp/flight_2.out; grep -c "Loading category" /tmp/flight_1.out /tmp/flight_2.out
tail -40 /tmp/next.log; cat /tmp/flight_2.out
sed -n 1,120p /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/parse-and-validate-flight-router-state.js 2>/dev/null || find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist -name "*flight-router-state*" | head

cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/parse-and-validate-flight-router-state.js; grep -rn "validateRSCPayload\|hasLoadingSegment\|const MAX_SEGMENT" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/router/utils/*valid* 2>/dev/null | head -3
grep -n "flightRouterStateSchema" -A 20 /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/types.js | head -40

TREE='["",{"children":["catalog",{"children":["__PAGE__",{}]}]}]'; ET=$(node -e "console.log(encodeURIComponent(process.argv[1]))" "$TREE"); for PM in 2 1; do curl -sL "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale" -H 'RSC: 1' -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: $PM" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: $ET" -H 'Next-Url: /' -o /tmp/flight_$PM.out -w "mode$PM: %{http_code} %{time_total}s size=%{size_download} redir=%{num_redirects}\n"; done; grep -c "Canvas Tote" /tmp/flight_2.out 2>/dev/null; grep -o "Products on sale" /tmp/flight_2.out 2>/dev/null | head -1; grep -c "Loading category" /tmp/flight_2.out 2>/dev/null; tail -3 /tmp/next.log

TREE='["",{"children":["catalog",{"children":["__PAGE__",{}]}]}]'; ET=$(node -e "console.log(encodeURIComponent(process.argv[1]))" "$TREE"); for i in 1 2 3; do curl -sL "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale" -H 'RSC: 1' -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 2" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: $ET" -H 'Next-Url: /' -o /dev/null -w "sale warm$i: %{http_code} in %{time_total}s\n"; done; curl -sL "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=featured" -H 'RSC: 1' -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 2" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: $ET" -H 'Next-Url: /' -o /tmp/flight_feat.out -w "feat cold: %{http_code} in %{time_total}s\n"; grep -o "Featured products" /tmp/flight_feat.out | head -1; grep -c "Desk Lamp" /tmp/flight_feat.out; grep -c "Canvas Tote" /tmp/flight_feat.out; curl -s 'http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale' | grep -c "Canvas Tote"
pkill -f "next-server|next start"; git -C /workspace diff --stat
